reasons.emulator:
Wave 38 row 38.6/38.9 (2026-09-15): EVE-NG's own live template
(intel+amd, identical) pins qemu_version 1.3.1 with no forced
-cpu flag - was silently running on 1.7.0/host here, the nearest
already-built version, not the one this old-kernel appliance was
actually validated against. Now built (see
infra/scripts/build-qemu-versions.sh) - fixed to match.
"cpu_model" must be an EXPLICIT non-"host" value here, never just
omitted - qemu.py's own resolver treats a missing key the same as
"host" (`profile.get("cpu_model") or "host"`), so "qemu64" (QEMU's
own safe old default, what a bare no -cpu-flag actually resolves
to) has to be spelled out or this profile silently keeps forcing
host-passthrough onto a 2013-era kernel - the exact failure class
already confirmed once in this project (vwlc).
